fluent.instructions: The text is fluent, grammatical English prose.

criteria.true: Reads as natural prose a competent writer produced.
criteria.false: Broken syntax, degenerate repetition, truncated mid-word, or nonsense.

quality.instructions: Rate the prose quality of this story continuation.

repetition.instructions: The text contains degenerate repetition (a word or phrase looping).

criteria.true: A word or phrase repeats in a way a writer would not.
